latest.title: Z-Deck 0.2.55-cyberdeck
latest.notes: Adds the integrated Z-Deck dashboard and Mesh Networks hub instead of exposing the stock Meshtastic home panel. Devices showing No MeshCore loaded or USB INSTALL NEEDED must run the dual-system USB installer once; it seeds both Z-Deck OTA slots and the dedicated MeshCore partition without writing NVS, LittleFS, SD files, channels, keys, or local preferences.
